heading: **30 October 2025**
body:
### 1. ligN40w107 PCR optimisation

Previously these ligands were halted at PCR1, because the product size seen for the DNA was incorrect. This was likely because the wrong b oligo was used i.e. the incorrect oligo from the earliest design for ligN40w107b. This is now being repeated with ligN40w107b-Re.

*![](assets/img/doc3-image3.png)*

Estimate the concentration of the annealed DNA product \= 

Dilute this DNA 15-fold ⇒ Make up the volume to 900 uL ⇒ Conc \= 5 ng/uL

Prepare a 100X reaction mix:

| Reagent | Volume (µL) |
| ----- | ----- |
| **ligN40w107 Ann** | **100** |
| **Phusion Master Mix** | **1250** |
| **NCAP\_F (10 µM)** | **125** |
| **NCAP\_R (10 uM)** | **125** |
| **Water** | **900**  |
| **Total** | **2500** |

Split mix into 25 uL per well for two 96-well PCR plates.

| 98°C | 3 min |
| :---- | :---- |
| 98°C | 10 s |
| 55°C | 15 s       **8X\*** |
| 72°C | 30 s |
| 72°C | 40 min |
| 4°C | HOLD |

Pool the PCR product and run 20 uL of sample on a 1% agarose gel. Measure concentration of the PCR1 product. The gel run showed the correct band size but the PCR product here is not as clean and there is a little bit of smearing, but the dominant band is for the correct size.

Concentration of PCR1 \= 13.2 ng/uL

### 2. Repeat of ligation for reconstitution

Large scale ligation with a mix of DNA i.e. lig147 & ligN40w107 did not yield very optimal sizes of fragments (L10)

This will therefore be repeated with the new lig147 pool. First prepare PNK treated DNA.

First take 296 uL (\~12 ug) of the lig147 PCR2 pool and concentrate this prior to setting up the PNK reaction as below:

**5X**

| DNA | up to 300 pmol of 5´ termini (Use 2 ug of DNA per reaction) |
| :---- | :---- |
| T4 PNK Reaction Buffer (10X) | 5 µl |
| ATP (10 mM) | 5 µl |
| [T4 PNK](https://www.neb.com/en-gb/products/m0201-t4-polynucleotide-kinase) | 1 µl (10 units) |
| Nuclease-free Water | up to 50 µl |

 

### 3. Reconstitution of lig20K with SBP-Octamer \+ TF pool incubation

*lig20K (2x)*

Use 3.89 ug of DNA

lig20K (D7) ⇒ 15 uL ⇒ 15 nM \[at 2 M salt concentration\]

Octamer molarity acc. to 60:1 ratio ⇒ 0.9 uM ⇒ 2.11 ug in 5 uL ⇒ Prepare 500 ng/uL stock OSH500 (0.83 uL \+ 11.17 uL refolding buffer) ⇒ (4.22 uL OHS500 \+ 0.78 uL refolding buffer \+ glycerol) \[1.84 M\]

Post-reconstitution, the assembled nucleosomes are to be enriched with SBP beads to enrich only the fragments of DNA with assembled nucleosomes.

Based on the actual NCAP-SELEX protocol, when the beads are added to the nucleosomes for purification, the actual salt concentration is \~0.17 M.
